json.rationale: A DatasetVersion is a specific instance or snapshot of a logical Dataset, fitting the definition of prov:specializationOf where the specialized entity (version) shares aspects of the general entity (dataset).
A Dataset can be considered a collection of Columns, and prov:hadMember links a collection to its members. This implies that Dataset should also be classified as prov:Collection.
A DatasetVersion can be considered a prov:Collection of its ColumnVersions, which are prov:Entity instances. The prov:hadMember property expresses this containment.
A ColumnVersion is a specific version, and thus a specialization, of a logical Column.
A JobVersion is a specific definition or instance of a logical Job, fitting the definition of prov:specializationOf where one entity is a more specific aspect of another.
The logical job (entity) defines the execution (activity), thereby influencing its character and behavior. prov:wasInfluencedBy is the most general predicate for such a relationship.
